title: Foreign Capital FDI FPI FII QFI
definition: Foreign Capital encompasses all financial flows from abroad into a domestic economy, categorized fundamentally into Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) involving managerial control and Foreign Portfolio Investment (FPI) involving financial asset ownership without direct control.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial microtopic for UPSC CSE Prelims (RBI regulations, FEMA, capital account convertibility, shareholding limits) and Mains GS Paper 3 (mobilization of resources, inclusive growth, macroeconomic stability, impact of foreign capital on domestic manufacturing and exchange rate).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Foreign Capital FDI FPI FII QFI.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Role of RBI and SEBI in financial markets
